originStory.title: Why Knowii Exists
originStory.subtitle: Born from personal frustration with information chaos
originStory.story: I had 2,000+ bookmarks scattered across 3 browsers. Notes in Evernote, Apple Notes, and dozens of paper notebooks. I'd read great books but couldn't remember or apply their key insights when I needed them most. I was drowning in emails, tabs, notes, and endless must-read content—overwhelmed by information, frustrated by scattered systems, burning hours searching for things I knew I'd saved somewhere. So I spent years teaching myself project management, team management, agile approaches, and leadership while organizing tons of knowledge and writing articles and books. Eventually, I built systems that actually worked—systems that turned chaos into clarity. Knowii exists because I realized these systems shouldn't stay locked in my head. They should help others break free from information overload and thrive in the age of AI.
originStory.inspirationPoint: The moment I realized my personal systems could help others transform their relationship with knowledge—not just survive information overload, but turn it into a competitive advantage.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years of Building Systems That Actually Work
creatorJourney.subtitle: From overwhelmed professional to knowledge management specialist
creatorJourney.story: My journey started like yours—drowning in information with no system to make sense of it all. Over 20+ years of professional experience, I've obsessively refined approaches to capturing, organizing, and leveraging knowledge. Along the way, I've published 400+ articles, written 3 books, created video courses, and built products used by thousands. I've sent 200+ editions of my newsletter to 2,300+ subscribers. But the real insight came from helping others: every system, every framework, every tool I share has been battle-tested in real professional situations—not just my own, but those of the 340+ community members and 2,000+ product customers who've trusted me to help them transform their knowledge work.
